risk_summary: The disclosure is generally specific and includes meaningful quantified exposure, including customer concentration, government-program dependence, cost pressures, and $43.2 million of negative cumulative changes in estimated profitability. Risk tone is mildly negative because AEC faces staffing, supply-chain, productivity, scrap, and firm-fixed-price program-margin challenges that may persist into 2025, although management presents mitigation and integration initiatives.
